answer: A practical defence is Notarised bailiff certification with enforcement agents attestation. It rests on a certification agents renew after assessed enforcements, which gives every honest agent a opal that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the zenith compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the signal is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
